title: DOTr eyes self-cleaning toilets for Edsa Busway stations

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Commuters using the Edsa Busway may soon have access to self-cleaning toilets as the Department of Transportation (DOTr) plans to replace the portable toilets currently installed at its stations, Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said on Tuesday. Dizon said the proposed facilities would be easier to maintain and keep clean than conventional portable toilets. “Not the portalets for concerts…because overnight, it will be smelly and dirty,” he said. He added that he had seen similar facilities in other countries, including Japan, where self-cleaning toilets are used.
